name: plantuml
description: PlantUML diagram renderer - UML and C4 (via C4-PlantUML stdlib) from text to PNG/SVG

plantuml.description: Renders .puml text diagrams to PNG/SVG; pairs with structurizr export -format plantuml/c4plantuml
plantuml.usage:
plantuml diagram.puml # Render to PNG next to source
plantuml -tsvg diagram.puml # Render to SVG
plantuml -DPLANTUML_LIMIT_SIZE=16384 big.puml # Raise canvas limit
plantuml -checkonly diagram.puml # Validate only
